prova:
refine ⟨muellerSet, ?_, ?_⟩
  -- AvoidsPowersOfTwo: for a,b in muellerSet, a+b is not a power of 2
  · intro a ha b hb k
    rcases ha with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨j, hj⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge i j with hlt | hge
    · have hsum : a + b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
        have ha_mod : a ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hi
        have hb_mod : b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ j [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
          have hdiv : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (i + 2) := by simpa using Nat.dvd_refl (2 ^ (i + 2))
          have hdiv2 : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (j + 2) := by
            have : i + 2 ≤ j + 2 := by omega
            exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 this
          have hdiv3 : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) - 3 * 2 ^ j := by
            have : 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) - 3 * 2 ^ j = 3 * 2 ^ j * (2 ^ 2 - 1) := by
              have : 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) = 3 * 2 ^ j * 2 ^ 2 := by ring
              have : 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) - 3 * 2 ^ j = 3 * 2 ^ j * 2 ^ 2 - 3 * 2 ^ j := by
                ring
              calc
                3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) - 3 * 2 ^ j
                  = 3 * 2 ^ j * 2 ^ 2 - 3 * 2 ^ j := by ring
                _ = 3 * 2 ^ j * (2 ^ 2 - 1) := by
                  have : 3 * 2 ^ j * 2 ^ 2 - 3 * 2 ^ j = 3 * 2 ^ j * (2 ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
                  exact this
            rw [this]
            have : 2 ^ 2 - 1 = 3 := by norm_num
            rw [this]
            norm_num
            <;> simp [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib]
            <;> ring
            <;> nlinarith
          have hdiv4 : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ j := by
            have : i + 2 ≤ j + 2 := by omega
            have hpow : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (j + 2) := Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 this
            have : 2 ^ (j + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) := by
              simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
            exact calc
              2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (j + 2) := hpow
              _ ∣ 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) := by simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
              _ ∣ 3 * 2 ^ j := by
                have : 3 * 2 ^ (j + 2) = 3 * 2 ^ j * 4 := by ring
                have : 2 ^ (j + 2) = 2 ^ j * 4 := by ring
                simp [this, *]
                <;> ring
                <;> nlinarith
          have hdiff : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ (3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ j) := by simpa using Nat.dvd_zero _
          have hsub : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ (3 * 2 ^ j - 0) := by simpa using hdiv4
          have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ (3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ j) := by simpa using hsub
          exact by simpa using this
        have hsum_mod : a + b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
          calc
            a + b ≡ (3 * 2 ^ i) + (3 * 2 ^ j) [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
              simpa [Nat.ModEq] using ha_mod.add hb_mod
            _ = 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j := by ring
        exact hsum_mod
      have hsum2 : a + b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
        have hdiv : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ i := by
          have : 3 * 2 ^ j = 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) := by
            have : j ≥ i := by omega
            have : j = i + (j - i) := by omega
            simp [this, Nat.pow_add]
            <;> ring
          have : 3 * 2 ^ i - 3 * 2 ^ i = 0 := by ring
          have : 3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i := by
            have : j = i + (j - i) := by omega
            simp [this]
            <;> ring
          have : 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by
            have : 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by
              have : 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) = 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 0 := by ring
              have : 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * 1 := by ring
              calc
                3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i
                  = 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i * 1 := by ring
                _ = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by ring
            exact this
          have : 2 ^ (j - i) - 1 ≥ 1 := by
            have : j - i ≥ 1 := by omega
            have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) this
            have : 2 ^ 1 = 2 := by norm_num
            have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 := by simpa [this] using this
            omega
          have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ i := by
            have : i + 2 ≤ i + (j - i) + 2 := by omega
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (i + (j - i) + 2) := Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)
            have : 2 ^ (i + (j - i) + 2) = 2 ^ (i + 2) * 2 ^ (j - i) := by
              have : i + (j - i) + 2 = (i + 2) + (j - i) := by omega
              simp [this, Nat.pow_add]
              <;> ring
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (i + 2) * 2 ^ (j - i) := by
              simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) * 2 ^ (j - i) = 3 * 2 ^ i * 3 * 2 ^ (j - i) / 3 := by
              have : 3 = 3 := rfl
              ring
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ i := by
              have : 2 ^ (i + 2) = 4 * 2 ^ i := by ring
              have : 4 * 2 ^ i ∣ 3 * 2 ^ i := by
                have : 4 ∣ 3 := by norm_num
                exact (by simp [this, *])
              simpa [this] using this
            exact this
          have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by
            exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (by simpa using this) (2 ^ (j - i) - 1)
          exact by simpa [*, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib] using this
        have hsum2_mod : 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
          have : 3 * 2 ^ j ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ i := hdiv
            simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
          have : 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
            simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this).add' (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (by norm_num : (3 * 2 ^ i : ℕ) ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)]))
          exact this
        calc
          a + b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ j [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hsum
          _ ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hsum2_mod
      have hsum3 : 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i = 6 * 2 ^ i := by ring
      have hsum4 : a + b ≡ 6 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
        calc
          a + b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hsum2
          _ ≡ 6 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
            have : 3 * 2 ^ i + 3 * 2 ^ i = 6 * 2 ^ i := by ring
            simpa [this] using (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (by norm_num : (6 * 2 ^ i : ℕ) ≡ 6 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)]))
      have hsum5 : 6 * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
        have : 6 * 2 ^ i = 2 * 3 * 2 ^ i := by norm_num
        have : 2 * 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 * 2 ^ i := by ring
        have : 3 * 2 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ (i + 1) := by
          have : 2 * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ (i + 1) := by ring
          simp [this]
          <;> ring
        calc
          6 * 2 ^ i = 2 * 3 * 2 ^ i := by norm_num
          _ = 3 * 2 * 2 ^ i := by ring
          _ = 3 * 2 ^ (i + 1) := by
            have : 2 * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ (i + 1) := by ring
            simp [this]
            <;> ring
          _ = 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by ring
      have hsum6 : a + b ≡ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
        calc
          a + b ≡ 6 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hsum4
          _ ≡ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
            have : 6 * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := hsum5
            simpa [this] using (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (by norm_num : (2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 : ℕ) ≡ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)]))
      have hnot : ¬ (a + b = 2 ^ k) := by
        intro h
        have : a + b ≡ 2 ^ k [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
          have : a + b = 2 ^ k := h
          simpa [this] using (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using (by norm_num : (2 ^ k : ℕ) ≡ 2 ^ k [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)]))
        have hdiv : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ k := by
          have : a + b ≡ 2 ^ k [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := this
          simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
        have hdiv2 : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b := by
          have : a + b ≡ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hsum6
          have : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
            simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
          have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
            have : 2 ^ (i + 2) = 2 * 2 ^ (i + 1) := by ring
            have : 2 * 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
              simpa [this] using this
            have : 2 * 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := this
            have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
              have : 2 * 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := this
              have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ 2 * 2 ^ (i + 1) := by
                simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
              exact (by simpa using this).trans (by simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _)
            exact this
          have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b := by
            have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ (a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3) + 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
              have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := this
              have : 2 ^ (i + 1) ∣ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
                simpa using Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _
              exact (by simpa using this).add (by simpa using this)
            have : (a + b - 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3) + 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 = a + b := by
              have : a + b ≥ 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 := by
                have : 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 = 6 * 2 ^ i := by
                  have : 2 ^ (i + 1) * 3 = 2 * 2 ^ i * 3 := by ring
                  have : 2 * 2 ^ i * 3 = 6 * 2 ^ i := by ring
                  exact this
                have : 6 * 2 ^ i ≤ a + b := by
                  have : a ≡ 3 * 2 ^ i [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := hi
                  have : b ≡ 3 * 2 ^ j [MOD 2 ^ (i + 2)] := by
                    have hdiv : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 2 ^ (j + 2) := by
                      have : i + 2 ≤ j + 2 := by omega
                      exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 this
                    have hdiv2 : 2 ^ (i + 2) ∣ 3 * 2 ^ j - 3 * 2 ^ i := by
                      have : 3 * 2 ^ j = 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) := by
                        have : j = i + (j - i) := by omega
                        simp [this, Nat.pow_add]
                        <;> ring
                      have : 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by
                        have : 3 * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ (j - i) = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1) := by
                          have : 2 ^ (j - i) = 2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1 := by
                            have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 1 := by
                              have : j - i ≥ 1 := by omega
                              have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) this
                              have : 2 ^ 1 = 2 := by norm_num
                              have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 := by simpa [this] using this
                              omega
                            have : 2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1 = 2 ^ (j - i) := by
                              have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 1 := by
                                have : j - i ≥ 1 := by omega
                                have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) this
                                have : 2 ^ 1 = 2 := by norm_num
                                have : 2 ^ (j - i) ≥ 2 := by simpa [this] using this
                                omega
                              omega
                            exact this
                          rw [this]
                          <;> ring
                        have : 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1) = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) + 3 * 2 ^ i := by
                          ring
                        have : 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1) - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) := by
                          have : 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1) - 3 * 2 ^ i = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) + 3 * 2 ^ i - 3 * 2 ^ i := by
                            have : 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1 + 1) = 3 * 2 ^ i * (2 ^ (j - i) - 1) + 3 * 2 ^ i := by
                              ring
                            rw [this]
                            <;> ring
